app.name: Surge
app.one_liner: Blazing fast TUI download manager built in Go for power users

screens.name: Main Download View
screens.purpose: Display active, queued, and completed downloads with real-time progress and status indicators.

screens.name: Settings Editor
screens.purpose: Configure download behavior, themes, categories, and daemon options with validation and restart-required warnings.

rust_commands.name: list_downloads
rust_commands.purpose: Retrieve current download queue and history from the daemon.

rust_commands.name: start_download
rust_commands.purpose: Initiate a new download job using URL and optional mirrors, handled by the background daemon.

rust_commands.name: update_settings
rust_commands.purpose: Apply validated user settings and trigger restart if required.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add CLI command to enqueue downloads
week 1: Build basic TUI with Bubble Tea showing active downloads
week 1: Implement core daemon with parallel chunked downloader
week 1: Persist download state to disk
week 2: Add settings screen with validation
week 2: Integrate mirror support and failover logic
acceptance_tests: After service start, client successfully connects to daemon without failure.
In Categories editor, typing 'j' or 'k' inserts characters instead of triggering navigation.
User can start a download via CLI and see it appear in the TUI within 1 second.
When a download starts, the 'Active' tab is automatically selected (per feature request).
